title: ADHD, Autism, Developmental Coordination Disorder, and Adult Social Functioning
background: This module evaluates overlap among ADHD, autism, and developmental coordination disorder and competing explanations for adult social and motor difficulties.
population: Adolescents and adults with ADHD, autism-spectrum disorder or traits, developmental coordination disorder, or overlapping profiles.
intervention: Single or co-occurring neurodevelopmental profiles, social-communication features, motor coordination, and developmental overlap.
comparator: Neurotypical controls, single-diagnosis groups, or alternative psychiatric and contextual explanations.

outcomes_primary.name: Diagnostic or trait overlap among ADHD, autism, and developmental coordination disorder
Social-communication, peer, adaptive, and motor outcomes

outcomes_secondary.name: Incremental explanatory value and alternative explanations

inclusion: Adolescent or adult sample with ADHD, autism, developmental coordination disorder, or validated traits.
Reports overlap, differential diagnosis, social communication, peer functioning, adaptive functioning, or motor coordination.
Provides empirical comparative data or an authoritative evidence synthesis.
exclusion: Pediatric-only sample with no relevance to persistence beyond adolescence.
Opinion or advocacy without empirical data.
No outcome relevant to claims H5 or H11.

analysis.effect_measure: Narrative synthesis; no pooling across diagnostic constructs.

registration: Protocol frozen for AI-assisted rapid review on 2026-07-29; not prospectively registered.
disclaimer: AI Reviewer-1 rapid-review draft. Human Reviewer 2 and clinical sign-off remain pending. Not diagnostic or treatment guidance.
